verses.en: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.sm: Siona i latou, e le faagaeetia, a e tumau e faavavau. O Ierusalema ua siosioina i mauga;

verses.en: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.sm: o le ALII foi na te siomia lona nuu, e amata mai nei lava, a e oo i le faavavau.

verses.en: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.sm: A4a o le tootoo o e amio leaga e le tumau lea i le tofi o e amiotonu; ina ne“ tago atu lima o e amiotonu i se amio leaga.

verses.en: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.sm: Le ALII e, ia e agalelei mai i e ua agalelei, ma e ua tonu O latou loto.

verses.en: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.sm: A o e liliu ane i le agapiopio, o le ALII na te ta‘ita‘iina i latou faatasi ma e o fai amio leaga; e ia Isaraelu le manuia.
